title: Rochdale Council Tax Direct Debits delayed by one day after system error
excerpt: Council Tax Direct Debits due on Monday 26 October will instead be collected on Tuesday 27 October, Rochdale Council says. The notice applies to the affected collection date.
body:
Residents whose Rochdale Council Tax Direct Debit was due to leave their account on Monday 26 October 2026 should expect it to be collected on Tuesday 27 October instead, following a system error at the council.

The authority has placed a notice across its official website explaining that payments scheduled for Monday 26 October will be taken one day later. It has not said in that notice how many accounts are affected, what caused the error or whether any other collection dates will change. The published change concerns this specific Monday collection date, not every Council Tax instalment.

For residents who budget closely around outgoing payments, the practical point is to leave enough money in the account for the revised Tuesday collection. A payment not showing as taken on Monday does not, by itself, mean the instalment has been cancelled. Residents should avoid making an additional manual payment simply because the usual Direct Debit has not yet appeared, without first checking their account or speaking to the council.

The council says residents can check their Council Tax balance through its MyAccount service. People who need help can contact the Council Tax team on 0300 303 8870. These are official council channels; no bank details should be supplied to an unsolicited caller or message claiming to be about the delay.

The notice was checked on Monday 26 October. It does not explain whether customers will receive individual notifications. Rochdale Daily will update this report if the council announces any further change.

Official information: https://www.rochdale.gov.uk/counciltax. Council Tax account guidance: https://www.rochdale.gov.uk/council-tax/council-tax-account-balance-enquiries. Council contact details: https://www.rochdale.gov.uk/contactcentre.

Was your collection affected, or did you receive a message from the council? Tell us in the comments without sharing personal account or banking details.
